workflows.name: watchdog
workflows.purpose: Reap rows stuck in status='processing' across product_carousel_queue and news_card_queue every 5 minutes; requeue if retry_count<3, terminate otherwise

workflows.name: auto_reply_comments
workflows.purpose: Monitor recent IG posts for new comments every 30 min, generate AI replies via GPT-4o-mini, auto-reply or auto-hide spam/hateful comments

workflows.name: lifestyle_mockup_pipeline
workflows.purpose: Daily: pick lifestyle image + random design combos, generate product mockup via ChatGPT image gen, save carousel assets to Google Drive Mockup Review folder

workflows.name: lifestyle_mockup_publisher
workflows.purpose: Daily 2pm PDT: detect approved mockups moved out of Review folder, queue and publish via Shared IG Publisher

workflows.name: error_alert
workflows.purpose: Error Trigger workflow — catches unhandled crashes from all other workflows and sends Slack alerts with workflow name, failed node, error message, and next steps

workflows.name: tiktok_video_factory
workflows.purpose: Batch-generate TikTok 'spotted in the wild' videos: for each design, generate start frame (back) + end frame (front with design) via ChatGPT image gen, consistency-check with GPT-4o vision, upload frame pairs to Google Drive, then generate video via Higgsfield
